citations.claim: EW approach E is red while NS is green at step 64
EW approach E still red while NS shows yellow at step 65
EW approach E turned green at step 66 with 0s all-red, first all_red_clearance violation

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event (W at t=66); otherwise identical. Without preemption the normal NS yellow + 4s all-red cycle completes and no violation occurs.

explanation: Emergency preemption for W at t=66 forces an immediate jump from NS yellow (step 65) directly to EW green (step 66), skipping the required yellow remainder (6s, only 1s served) and skipping the 4s all-red clearance (0s served). Thus both EW approaches turn green with 0s of opposite-red time.

violation.detail: approach 1 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 4 s)

vision_note: Steps 63-64 show one axis green with the cross axis red, and step 65 shows that green axis turning yellow. Step 66 then immediately shows the perpendicular axis green with no intervening all-red clearance interval.
